measurementNotes: Single sequential software-rendered run; no hardware GPU speedup claim. Initial startup uses a fresh terrain runtime with warm browser/material caches, not full application launch.
Stationary and moving metrics use 60 frames each; movement advances .25 m/frame, so wall-clock velocity depends on frame rate. The maximum-distance probe advances .5 m/frame for 120 frames.
Generation throughput is completions per wall-clock second during the 120-frame observation. Resource counts are observed while streaming, so resident sets may differ between modes and versions.
Baseline lacked request, eviction, residency-hit and installation counters; these fields are null rather than measured zeros. Baseline meshing CPU includes installation, while current separates them.

Initial voxel load and fresh polygonal load are measured separately. Switch latency includes rendering throughout replacement. Maximum-distance snapshots are cumulative at the end of the movement probe.
